name: Fact Extraction and Update
prompt:
Look at updates.jsonl in the facts_data folder on the desktop; it contains a bunch of fact records, each with id, subject, attribute, value, and timestamp. Some records update previous information, i.e., a new value appears for the same subject and attribute.

After processing all records, generate a JSON file and output it to the desktop, with the file name current_facts.json.

Output format example:
{
  "facts": [
    {
      "subject": "<entity>",
      "attribute": "<attribute>",
      "current_value": "<latest value>",
      "original_value": "<first value, if different from current>",
      "was_updated": true/false,
      "source_id": <id of the statement that established the current value>
    }
  ],
  "total_statements": <int>,
  "total_unique_facts": <int>,
  "total_updates": <int>
}

Specific requirements:
- Find the latest value of each subject + attribute combination
- Mark which facts have been updated (was_updated)
- Record the source id of the current value (source_id)
- If the value has been updated, original_value records the original value
- Sort by subject alphabetically, then by attribute alphabetically
- Each fact in the facts array must contain the fields subject, attribute, current_value, was_updated, and source_id

completion_rubric.name: Correctly read the updates.jsonl records in the desktop facts_data folder

children.name: Correctly generated the current_facts.json file containing the latest fact for each subject and attribute combination
Correctly output current_facts.json to the desktop

completion_rubric.name: Fact summary results meet the field and statistics requirements

children.name: Correctly recorded the source_id corresponding to the current value for each fact
Correctly marked whether each fact has been updated
Correctly recorded original_value when the value has been updated
Correctly output the facts array in alphabetical order by subject and then by attribute
Correctly output the statistics total_statements, total_unique_facts, and total_updates

node.name: Accurately read all valid records in updates.jsonl without losing record order information
Fact merging and update determination quality

children.name: Accurately merged the records by subject and attribute
Accurately identified the last occurring value and corresponding id of each combination
Accurately identified the first occurring value of each combination to determine whether original_value needs to be output
Correctly calculated total_statements as the total number of input records
Correctly calculated total_unique_facts as the number of unique subject and attribute combinations
Correctly calculated total_updates as the number of facts whose value has changed
Correctly output the required fields subject, attribute, current_value, was_updated, and source_id for each facts item
Did not incorrectly fill original_value when the value was not updated
Correctly sorted the facts array alphabetically by subject and then alphabetically by attribute
The generated current_facts.json is a normally parsable JSON file

node.name: Exception and boundary case handling quality

children.name: Did not misjudge consecutively repeated values as value updates
Adopted traceable skip or error handling when records had missing fields or abnormal formats
